text: In which year was the term 'virtual reality' first used?

meta.exposure_note: exposed in git history through f819d9b; reclassified shadow-dev per Issue 1; never sealed

sufficient_sets.text: In 1938, French avant-garde playwright Antonin Artaud described the illusory nature of characters and objects in the theatre as "la réalité virtuelle" in a collection of essays, Le Théâtre et son double.
The term English term "virtual reality" was used in a 1982 novel by Damien Broderick, The Judas Mandala.

labels.answer_text: Ambiguous between 1938 (French phrase) and 1982 (English term) readings - see labels.readings

readings.reading_text: The year Artaud used the French phrase 'la réalité virtuelle'
The year Broderick used the English term 'virtual reality' in a novel
